original_cover_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / finished music-video cover.
Create ONE finished LANDSCAPE 16:9 cover image, ideally 2048x1152 pixels, for the existing fan MV of Mili's world.search(you);. It must work as a clear, striking video thumbnail at small sizes.
Input images: Image1 official Bonnie appearance reference; Image2 official Fanny appearance reference. Images3 and4 are the finished v4 music video's black-white-pink / black-white-gold character art references and reaching-pose references. Preserve their identities, recognizable face shapes, hairstyles, actual peaked detective cap shapes, coat details, gloves and neckties. Do not merge the two characters' designs. The official images control identity; images3/4 control graphic art style.
Composition: strong balanced two-character waist-up portrait, Bonnie occupies left third and faces right; Fanny occupies right third and faces left. Their expressive faces are large and readable. Bonnie has silver-white hair, a dark decorated peaked cap and pink eyes; Fanny has her side ponytail, white peaked cap with shield badge and gold/black visor. Both extend one hand toward the center, fingertips separated by a small gap on opposite sides of a thin luminous vertical screen boundary. Bonnie's free hand holds a poison apple; Fanny's free hand holds a magnifying glass. Natural human hands and readable silhouettes. A restrained determined expression for Bonnie; gentle surprised recognition for Fanny. Full hats visible, no awkward cropping of fingers or faces.
Art direction: polished anime music-video key visual, crisp inking, bold hard-edge poster cel shading. Black and white with Bonnie's hot pink-violet #FF4FA8 and Fanny's golden yellow #FFC24A. Broad white highlights and deep black shadow shapes, highly graphic, rich controlled contrast. Background deep blue-black #0A0F17 to true black. Left background suggests an old amber CRT with subtle curved scanlines and sparse amber character fragments; right background suggests a clean OLED with gold dot-matrix fragments dissolving from Fanny's outer silhouette. Keep these effects outside the important face/hand regions. The narrow center boundary glows warm white, with a small connecting signal at the fingertips. A faint empty search-box outline near the bottom connects the story. Sparse interface hairlines and particles only; no clutter.
Typography is part of the final design: reserve the upper 22% as a calm dark header. Put ONE large, exceptionally legible code-like monospaced title on a SINGLE LINE, exact text: "world.search(you);". Correct lowercase letters, dot, parentheses and final semicolon are essential. White bold title; the substring "you" may have a restrained pink/gold accent. Beneath it, one smaller clean readable credit line, exact text: "MILI · 邦妮 × 芬妮". No other readable text. Keep all typography and faces within a 6% safe margin. Make the title and faces the two clear hierarchies, with large clean shapes that read at 320px thumbnail size.
Output a complete opaque finished cover, exact 16:9 landscape aspect, edge-to-edge image without letterbox bars or mockup frame. No watermarks, no platform logos, no extra characters, no extra limbs, no sexualized framing, no diffuse photorealistic rendering, no heavy blur over text or faces.
hand_correction_prompt:
Precise localized image edit. Image1 is the FULL COVER and the ONLY edit target. Image2 is a crop identifying the malformed central hands. Return the ENTIRE finished cover at the same landscape aspect ratio and composition as Image1.
Change ONLY the TWO REACHING HANDS in the central area, including the smallest necessary adjoining wrist region. Preserve both faces, hair, hats, all clothing outside that small region, the poison apple, the magnifying glass, all typography (exactly world.search(you); and MILI · 邦妮 × 芬妮), screen border, colors, background details, layout, framing and illustration style unchanged.
Fix the anatomy by simplifying the gesture: Bonnie's pink-gloved reaching hand on the LEFT extends ONE index finger toward the center-right. Fanny's black glove with gold highlights on the RIGHT extends ONE index finger toward center-left. The two index fingertips almost meet across the vertical light boundary, separated by a small clean visible gap of about 12–20 pixels at this canvas size. Each hand has exactly five anatomically plausible digits: one index extended, middle/ring/little fingers naturally curled into the palm, thumb relaxed separately against the curled fingers. Show coherent knuckles, normal finger taper and lengths, believable palm-to-wrist attachment, matching glove material and existing cel shading. No second raised finger or V-sign. No forked fingers, duplicated digits, extra joints, intersecting fingers, spidery fingers or fused fingertips. Keep the central light but prevent its flare from obscuring the fingertip silhouettes.
All changes must remain local to the malformed reaching hands shown in Image2. The other two hands holding the apple and magnifier must remain unchanged. Maintain the existing polished black-white-pink/gold anime poster art and all title text exactly. Do not invent any additional objects or text. Opaque full cover, no transparency.
notes: Final image preserves cover layout and changes the malformed reaching hands to one extended index finger per hand.
